name: delivery_reliability
business_description: Regional daily customer delivery reliability, preserving delivered and attempted cohorts for transparent denominators.
grain: One row per destination country, region and UTC metric_date with an effective delivery outcome.

columns.name: metric_date
columns.description: UTC date of delivered or failed attempt outcome.

columns.name: delivered_shipments
columns.description: Distinct shipments delivered during the day.

columns.name: on_time_deliveries
columns.description: Delivered shipments meeting original dispatch promise.

columns.name: late_deliveries
columns.description: Delivered shipments missing original dispatch promise.

columns.name: completed_delivery_attempts
columns.description: Distinct attempts with a delivery or failure outcome on this day.

columns.name: failed_delivery_attempts
columns.description: Distinct failed attempts with outcome on this day.

columns.name: on_time_delivery_rate
columns.description: on_time_deliveries / delivered_shipments; null if no delivered shipments.

columns.name: failed_delivery_rate
columns.description: failed_delivery_attempts / completed_delivery_attempts; null if no outcomes.

columns.name: p95_transit_seconds
columns.description: Exact interpolated 95th percentile of delivered cohort transit time; null if none.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.description: Deterministic snapshot cutoff (as_of); actual publication wall time is stored in the release manifest.

freshness_sla.measurement: Time from Kinesis arrival (or local simulated ingress) of newest eligible accepted input to successful publication of a snapshot that includes it. Also alert if scheduled publication heartbeat is overdue. Do not infer freshness from an unchanged business timestamp.

completeness_sla.denominator: Distinct destination country, region and UTC outcome-date keys among effective DELIVERED and DELIVERY_FAILED events.
completeness_sla.measurement: Accepted-population product coverage only: matched expected keys / expected keys at committed input high-water mark. Independent source completeness requires generator expected-ID manifest; unknown without source control totals. Empty denominator is not_applicable. Report rejected, orphaned, and pending records separately.

quality_rules.description: Every row has a complete business key.
Published snapshot has one row per declared grain.
Publication clock is not more than five minutes ahead of evaluation time.

parameters.expected_population: Distinct destination country, region and UTC outcome-date keys among effective DELIVERED and DELIVERY_FAILED events.

quality_rules.description: Compare expected and published keys using the same committed input snapshot after the lateness allowance.

lineage.transformation: Aggregate delivery and failed-attempt outcomes by destination and outcome event date; retain counts for correct reaggregation. Never average percentages or percentile values.

prohibited_uses: Representing real customers, company operations, or measured production adoption
Financial settlement or physical stock reconciliation
usage_metadata.access_pattern: Partition-pruned Parquet snapshots; Redshift serving projection where justified.

cost_metadata.allocation_method: Storage by measured object bytes; shared job compute allocated by measured input bytes, explicitly an estimate. Report unallocated shared and AWS service charges separately.
